newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Avesta 6-mo seen 169 mln skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Avesta 6-mo seen 169 mln skr.

text.p: British-Swedish steel producer Avesta Sheffield was expected to show a pre-tax profit of 169 million crowns for the first six months of the split financial year, a Reuter poll of 10 analysts found on Monday.

This would represent a dramatic fall on the 2.29 billion crowns posted in the same 1995 period. The company reported a pre-tax profit of 228 million crowns for the first quarter (April - June) of the current financial year.

The forecasts ranged between break-even and 368 million crowns. Such a wide forecast interval is common for Avesta, whose result is highly sensitive to steel prices. Two months' delay in an upturn on the market can have drastic effects.
"A 10 percent upturn in the price of steel would bolster their result by over a billion crowns," one analyst said.
Analysts expected a profit of 764 million crowns for the full financial year 1996/97. The comparative figure for the 1995/96 financial year was 4.30 billion crowns.
The profit for the 1997/98 financial year was seen at 1.56 billion crowns, and for 1998/99 analysts expected a profit of 2.31 billion crowns.
Avesta is due to publish its six-month figures on November 8.
Sources: Handelsbanken, Swedbank, Enskilda, Foreningsbanken, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Fiba Nordic, Aros, Carnegie, James Capel, Ohman.
